topic_desc: The Supply Plant is an auxiliary structure of the Pitt Steelyard, originally built to house extra supplies for the steelworkers of the pre-war Pittsburgh foundry. Before the Great War, the plant's management began replacing human workers with Protectron robots, initially claiming the machines would serve only as security. Supervisor Tom McMullin attempted to stall the layoffs but ultimately could not prevent them. When the displaced workers discovered the truth, they revolted. McMullin, having anticipated the violence, fled and locked himself inside a small room. When the new Protectron workforce arrived, the robots killed the remaining human workers rather than protecting them. McMullin's terminal entries document his growing dread, culminating in his final log describing the sound of a killer Protectron approaching his door. By 2277, the plant is overrun with Trogs and occupied by Wildmen. Eighteen Steel Ingots remain inside. A factory Protectron in a repair chamber can be reactivated, and a makeshift baseball field has been constructed in one of the upper rooms. The unique Auto Axe variant known as the Man Opener rests on a bed on the top floor.
topic_desc_basic: The Supply Plant is an auxiliary of the Pitt Steelyard, accessed from within the Steelyard itself. Before the Great War, management replaced human workers with Protectrons, triggering a violent revolt. Supervisor Tom McMullin locked himself in a room but the Protectrons killed the remaining workers. The plant contains eighteen Steel Ingots and is overrun with Trogs and Wildmen. A unique Auto Axe called the Man Opener can be found on the top floor, and a dormant factory Protectron can be reactivated.
tags: man opener auto axe,pre-war labor revolt,protectron worker replacement,steel ingots supply plant,supply plant pitt,tom mcmullin supervisor

topic_desc: The Mobile Base Crawler, originally a Space Shuttle Orbiter mobile launch platform at Adams Air Force Base, was repurposed by the Enclave into a heavily fortified command and research facility. The crawler houses a Research and Development laboratory where Deathclaws are subjected to experimentation, training grounds for Enclave Squad Sigma, medical bays, armories protected by repulsion fields, and a satellite control tower capable of commanding the Enclave's orbital bombardment system. The interior is divided into four sections: the base floor, where Enclave engineer Stiggs can be found; the launch platform base, containing the Deathclaw research facility and medical quarters; the roof, with three Vertibird landing pads and Sentry Bot emplacements; and the satellite control tower, which houses the uplink terminal for orbital strikes. The crawler represents the Enclave's most significant remaining military asset in the Capital Wasteland following the loss of Raven Rock and Project Purity. Its capture or destruction became the decisive engagement of the Brotherhood-Enclave war, as the orbital satellite under its command could strike targets across the wasteland, including the Citadel itself. The Brotherhood later reclaimed substantial weapons and technology from the crawler's wreckage.
topic_desc_basic: The Mobile Base Crawler is a large Enclave command base at Adams Air Force Base, converted from a pre-war Space Shuttle Orbiter mobile platform. It contains a Deathclaw research lab, Enclave Squad Sigma training facilities, armories behind repulsion fields, medical bays, and a satellite control tower capable of directing orbital bombardment. The crawler is the Enclave's most significant remaining military asset in the Capital Wasteland and the site of the final Brotherhood-Enclave engagement.

topic_desc: The Maintenance Level aboard Mothership Zeta serves as the vessel's waste disposal and maintenance infrastructure. Accessible only through a teleportation matrix adjacent to the Robot Assembly, the level descends through several decks via a trash compactor lift. Sally, a young abductee who has learned to navigate the ship's corridors, attempts to repair a control panel on a Zeta trash can to explore deeper. The compactor stops at multiple levels, revealing glimpses of stored cargo: abducted brahmin, a pristine Corvega automobile, and alien crew quarters. The descent ends abruptly when the compactor plummets, depositing its occupants in a detritus-filled lower area. Among the items scattered through the waste disposal corridors are a military footlocker containing General Chase's Overcoat and an Anchorage Quartermaster Shipment holotape, Alien Captive Recorded Log #19, and the Samurai's Sword belonging to Toshiro Kago. Many objects in this area belonged to individuals featured in the alien captive recordings. Once Sally leads a visitor out, the teleporter to the Maintenance Level is permanently disabled, making return impossible.
topic_desc_basic: The Maintenance Level is a section of Mothership Zeta, the alien vessel encountered in the Capital Wasteland. It is accessible via a teleportation matrix near the Robot Assembly area. The level consists of waste disposal systems and trash compactors that descend through multiple decks of the ship. Sally, one of the abducted captives aboard Zeta, guides visitors through this area. The Maintenance Level can only be visited once; after departure, its teleporter is permanently disabled.

topic_desc: Before the Great War, Washington, D.C. served as the seat of the United States government, housing the Capitol Building, the White House, the Washington Monument, the Lincoln Memorial, and numerous museums along the Mall. By October 2077, the White House had been effectively abandoned; the president had secretly relocated to Control Station ENCLAVE, a Poseidon Energy oil rig off the coast of San Francisco, and the White House Press Corps was unofficially disbanded. Only a skeleton crew of laborers remained to maintain the property. After the bombs fell, a crater was all that remained at the White House's location. The city's extensive metro network, once advertised as a faster, cleaner commuter option, became the primary means of traversing the ruined districts when above-ground routes were impassable. The Brotherhood of Steel arrived at the former Pentagon in 2255, establishing the Citadel as their headquarters and discovering the pre-War robotic super weapon Liberty Prime within. The Jefferson Memorial was later selected as the site for Project Purity, a water purification initiative. The Capital Post served as the city's newspaper. The ruins are now home to super mutants, Talon Company mercenaries, ghouls in the Underworld settlement beneath the Museum of History, and slavers from Paradise Falls operating near the Lincoln Memorial.
topic_desc_basic: Washington, D.C. was the pre-War capital district of the United States. After the Great War of 2077, its radioactive ruins and surrounding areas became known as the Capital Wasteland. Notable landmarks include the Mall, the Washington Monument, the Lincoln Memorial, the Capitol Building, the White House, and several museums. An extensive metro system once served the city and its neighboring communities. The city's newspaper was the Capital Post. The ruins are now contested by super mutants, raiders, and various factions.

topic_desc: The National Guard Depot was a pre-War military compound situated along the northern edge of Downtown Washington, D.C., directly south of Vault 108 and the Robot Repair Center. Decades of neglect have left the above-ground structure severely damaged, with collapsed floors and ceilings creating hazardous navigation conditions throughout the building. Despite this deterioration, the underground bunker and its incomplete extension have survived with minimal damage. The facility is primarily patrolled by sentry bots, Mister Gutsys, protectrons, and robobrains that continue their automated defense routines long after their human operators perished. The depot consists of several interconnected sections: the main depot building, a training wing, offices, an armory, and the bunker. The armory contains a sealed storage room in its basement where a Small Guns bobblehead can be found on a shelf. The bunker, accessible through the armory, houses the Experimental MIRV, a unique Fat Man variant considered the single most powerful weapon in the Capital Wasteland, along with five mini nukes and a U.S. Army flamethrower recipe manual. Mr. Keller, now a glowing one and the last surviving member of the original Keller family, inhabits the bunker. The Keller family sought refuge in the bunker during or after the Great War, and their story is documented through a series of holotape transcripts scattered across the Capital Wasteland. Brotherhood Outcast patrols are known to operate in the vicinity of the depot.
topic_desc_basic: The National Guard Depot is a pre-War military installation along the northern edge of Downtown D.C. It served as a National Guard compound before the Great War. The above-ground structure has been severely damaged over the years, with collapsed floors and ceilings making navigation difficult. However, an underground bunker has survived largely intact. The depot is primarily inhabited by sentry bots, Mister Gutsys, protectrons, and robobrains. It is located directly south of Vault 108 and the Robot Repair Center.

topic_desc: Before the Great War, the United States Capitol Building housed the legislative branch of the federal government, situated atop Capitol Hill at the east end of the Mall in Washington, D.C., with its opposite side opening onto Seward Square. Following the Great War, the structure became one of the most dangerous locations in the Capital Wasteland, serving as a battleground between super mutants and Talon Company mercenaries. The complex is divided into four interconnected areas. The west entrance, accessible from the Mall, and the east entrance, accessible from Seward Square, provide the two surface-level access points. Deeper within lies the Hall of Columns, and beyond that, a conference room at the building's far end. The Rotunda, at the heart of the complex, is dominated by a Super Mutant Behemoth, with numerous additional mutants of varying sizes throughout the chamber. Mark VIII defense turrets installed in the Rotunda are configured to ignore Talon Company mercenaries, though their targeting data can be cleared. With the Enclave's arrival in the Capital Wasteland, the area surrounding the Capitol Building became a three-way conflict zone. Enclave Vertibirds have been observed carpet-bombing the area east of the building with mini nukes. An Enclave camp was established near the main entrance following significant developments in the region's water supply situation. The building's image appears on the cover of Lying, Congressional Style, a pre-War publication.
topic_desc_basic: The Capitol Building is a ruined structure in Washington, D.C., located at the east end of the Mall. Before the Great War, it housed the legislative branch of the United States government. The other side of the building opens onto Seward Square. The complex consists of four areas: the west entrance, the east entrance, the Hall of Columns, and a conference room. A Super Mutant Behemoth occupies the Rotunda at the center. The building is a contested battle site between super mutants, Talon Company mercenaries, and the Enclave.

topic_desc: Dupont Circle sits in the southeastern part of the Capital Wasteland's urban D.C. ruins. The roundabout's parkway encircles a defunct fountain, and the surrounding streets and alleyways are littered with frag mines. The northern sunken roadway, near the rear of the Galaxy News Radio building, is guarded by feral ghouls; rubble blocks direct passage from there into the circle proper, forcing travelers to detour through a ghoul-infested collapsed car tunnel. The southern end of the sunken road connects to Dupont Circle Station and a second car tunnel access door. The area hosts the largest concentration of raiders in the D.C. ruins, numbering nearly two dozen, along with feral ghouls and vicious dogs. Notable establishments include Lady Frumperton's Fashions, situated between Dupont Station and Dupont East. A poster advertises Dupont Station beneath the circle's recent remodel.
topic_desc_basic: Dupont Circle is a ruined roundabout in the northern urban D.C. area of the Capital Wasteland. A non-working fountain sits at its center, surrounded by grassy areas and sidewalks. The location is heavily mined and infested with raiders and feral ghouls. Access is possible through metro tunnels, a collapsed car tunnel, or a one-way rear exit from the Galaxy News Radio building.

topic_desc: The Rivet City Science Lab was founded after the discontinuation of Project Purity, providing Dr. Madison Li and her colleagues a permanent base for scientific research aboard the aircraft carrier settlement. The lab's primary endeavors involve hydroponic agriculture, cultivating fresh apples and potatoes, and developing a portable power supply later adopted by the Brotherhood of Steel after the Enclave halted the relaunch of Project Purity. The facility is accessible through three entrances: two from the midship deck, one connecting to the Common Room and another to a hallway near the Capitol Preservation Society, plus a door linking to the upper deck behind water and grain silos. The central room downstairs houses a large intersection of pipes leading to a circular platform, possibly a purifier or filter, alongside a large piece of machinery. Chemistry sets, fresh produce, and equipment fill the workspace. Dr. Zimmer and Armitage have also been observed visiting the lab.
topic_desc_basic: The Rivet City Science Lab is the research facility aboard Rivet City, led by Dr. Madison Li and her team. Research focuses on hydroponics, growing fresh produce, and developing a portable power supply. The lab was established after Project Purity was discontinued, giving Dr. Li and her colleagues a place to continue their work. Staff include Janice Kaplinski, Anna Holt, and Garza.

topic_desc: The Rivet City Market occupies the hangar deck of the grounded aircraft carrier that serves as the settlement of Rivet City. It functions as the primary commercial hub for the community, hosting five distinct vendors. Cindy Cantelli runs A Quick Fix, Bannon operates Potomac Attire, Flak and Shrapnel manage a shared weapons and repair business, Seagrave Holmes sells goods from Rivet City Supply, and Gary and Angela Staley serve food at Gary's Galley. The market opens for business at 8:00 AM, though merchants begin selling earlier. Morning visitors often find shopkeepers eating breakfast at Gary's Galley before returning to their stalls. Rivet City guards enforce closing hours, asking lingering visitors to leave and turning hostile if they refuse. Flak and Shrapnel share a single store inventory, so even if one is absent the other continues to provide repair and vending services. The market has a long history as a trading post; some who passed through in their youth later recalled scraping by as traders among these stalls.
topic_desc_basic: The Rivet City Market is the main business center of Rivet City, located on the aircraft carrier's former hangar deck. Five merchants operate there: Cindy Cantelli at A Quick Fix, Bannon at Potomac Attire, Flak and Shrapnel at their weapons shop, Seagrave Holmes at Rivet City Supply, and Gary and Angela Staley at Gary's Galley. The market opens at 8:00 AM.

topic_desc: Rockbreaker's Last Gas is a derelict fueling station in the Capital Wasteland, situated in a region rich with industrial history. The site takes its name from the high-quality shale once quarried in the vicinity. The station sits at a crossroads of sorts: north of Everglow National Campground, south of Five Axles Rest Stop, and east of both Vault 87 and Broadcast Tower KT8. To the west, perched high on a cliff, a small abandoned shack can be found. The surrounding area is dangerous, with super mutant brutes, centaurs, and super mutant masters armed with miniguns known to patrol the vicinity. After the Enclave's activities at Project Purity, an Enclave camp appears nearby, making the location even more hazardous. A Nuka-Cola Quantum rests atop a vending machine within the fenced compound. The entrance to the quarry features a roadside approach where travelers may encounter unpredictable threats.
topic_desc_basic: Rockbreaker's Last Gas is a ruined gas station in the Capital Wasteland, located north of Everglow National Campground, south of Five Axles Rest Stop, and east of Vault 87 and Broadcast Tower KT8. The area was named after high-quality shale quarried nearby. A Nuka-Cola Quantum can be found atop a vending machine inside the fenced area.

topic_desc: GNR Plaza is a focal point of conflict between Super Mutants and the Brotherhood of Steel in the Capital Wasteland. The main lobby is heavily fortified with sandbags and barricades, staffed by named Brotherhood members wielding flamers, missile launchers, and laser rifles. Balconies flank the lobby, and upstairs offices lead to the recording studio where Three Dog broadcasts his radio program. The plaza's alley has been the site of engagements between Lyons' Pride and Super Mutants, and at least one Super Mutant Behemoth has been observed emerging from behind a wrecked bus to attack Brotherhood forces there. The building's main doors remain locked and inaccessible until the plaza is secured. A side entrance on the eastern face requires climbing and presents a very difficult lock. A blocked metro entrance nearby bears signage for GNR Plaza Station, though that station is never accessible. An unfinished third floor exists behind a very hard lock above the studio, reachable only through a debris-filled room with holes in the floor and ceiling.
topic_desc_basic: The Galaxy News Radio building and its plaza sit in the Chevy Chase district of the ruins of Washington, D.C. The plaza centers on a sculptured fountain and a caved-in metro entrance. The Brotherhood of Steel fortifies the station entrance with sandbags and posts armed sentries on the steps and balconies. The building serves as both a radio broadcast home and a Brotherhood of Steel forward base in the Capital Wasteland.
tags: brotherhood of steel,chevy chase district,fortified radio station,galaxy news radio,super mutant behemoth,three dog broadcast

topic_desc: Takoma Park is a dangerous and contested area of the Capital Wasteland, overrun by Super Mutants and occasionally patrolled by Super Mutant Overlords. A Super Mutant Behemoth lurks near the auto shop, and an artillery strike mechanism atop a trailer next to the water tower can be triggered to assist in fighting it, though the strike has a short cooldown. Talon Company mercenaries have been known to ambush travelers at the derelict home and near Takoma Industrial. The derelict house serving as the passage to Takoma Industrial contains an ignitable gas leak near its oven. Behind Takoma Industrial lies Isabella Proud's Camp, accessible only by traversing the factory roof and crossing an irradiated canal via pipes or a downed antenna tower. Isabella Proud conducted research there on a subject she called "Samuel," an alpha male specimen. Her computer terminal contains her research notes. A rigged baby carriage trap sits atop a car near Nifty Thrifty, and explosive gas and frag mines guard the bow's interior passages. After significant developments at the Jefferson Memorial, Enclave Vertibirds have been observed flying over the area near Nifty Thrifty.
topic_desc_basic: Takoma Park is a small shopping center in the Capital Wasteland, built around a pre-War office park adjacent to a metro station, a bank, and the Nifty Thrifty pawnshop. Brownstone townhouses line the streets to the south and high-rise apartment buildings to the north. The area is infested with Super Mutants and provides the only access to Takoma Industrial through the Vernon East Takoma Park subway tunnels.
tags: isabella proud camp,nifty thrifty pawnshop,super mutant behemoth,takoma industrial access,takoma park shopping center,talon company ambush

topic_desc: The Tenpenny Tower Suite is among the most luxurious private residences in the Capital Wasteland, available only to those who have rendered significant service to Mr. Burke's designs regarding the settlement of Megaton. The suite's Mister Handy, Godfrey, provides purified water and grooming services. The balcony connects to Tenpenny Tower's own balcony and offers a vantage point from which the surrounding wasteland can be observed; it also serves as a practical exit point for those wishing to depart the tower on foot toward distant destinations. The suite can be extensively customized through purchases from Lydia Montenegro or Michael Masters, both of whom operate within Tenpenny Tower. Available improvements include an infirmary, a jukebox, a laboratory, a pristine Nuka-Cola machine, and a workbench. Decor themes range from Raider and Wasteland Explorer to Vault, Science, Pre-War, and Love Machine motifs. A Vault Theme adds an additional storage locker. If both Lydia and Michael are deceased, no further improvements can be made. The suite's bed provides a restful environment conducive to extended recovery. A copy of "Lying, Congressional Style" can be found on a desk when the Love Machine Theme is installed.
topic_desc_basic: The Tenpenny Tower Suite is a comfortable, roughly square-shaped room within Tenpenny Tower, featuring a king-sized bed, a large bookcase, a bobblehead collector's stand, and a balcony adjoining Mr. Tenpenny's own balcony with a commanding view of the surrounding wasteland. A Mister Handy unit named Godfrey serves the suite, dispensing purified water, telling jokes, and offering hairstyle changes. Storage includes a wardrobe, safe, desk, and footlocker.

topic_desc: The Rivet City Bow is a hazardous and largely abandoned section of the aircraft carrier, separated from the main settlement and claimed by Pinkerton after his removal from the Rivet City council. The underwater entrance from the flight deck side demands a long swim with a hollow section midway where travelers can pause for air. Mirelurks infest the bow and are known to respawn over time. The alternative entrance, a very hard-locked door on a pier southwest of Rivet City, can also be unlocked from inside via a power switch, though a frag mine sits atop an ammunition box near that door. The bow's interior is riddled with traps: rigged shotguns, frag mines, a grenade bouquet triggered by tripwire, and gas-filled hallways. A remotely activated door requires an activation switch found on the opposite wall. Pinkerton's lab contains a Big Book of Science, Dean's Electronics, three Stealth Boys, a D.C. Journal of Internal Medicine, and components for various custom weapons, though all are considered stolen property. Pinkerton's presence in the bow reflects the political tensions within Rivet City's governance, as he was ousted from the council and retreated to this isolated section rather than leaving the carrier entirely.
topic_desc_basic: The Rivet City Bow is the broken-off front third of the derelict aircraft carrier that houses Rivet City. Pinkerton, the former Rivet City council member removed in a political coup, has established his lab in a former storage shed within the bow. Access requires swimming through an underwater door from the flight deck, past Mirelurk guards, or through a very hard-locked door on a small pier southwest of Rivet City.
tags: aircraft carrier wreck,mirelurk infestation,pinkerton lab,rivet city bow,rivet city politics,underwater access

topic_desc: Rock Creek Caverns are a subterranean complex northwest of the National Guard Depot, accessible through a sewer grate exposed at the bottom of a crater. The caverns consist of a single large interior chamber that incorporates remnants of the pre-war metro system, with numerous tunnels and offshoots branching from a central hall. The area is heavily infested with Mirelurks, including Hunters and Kings, suggesting the creatures have established a significant nesting presence. Portions of the caverns are moderately radioactive. Notable features include a suspended automobile near the ceiling where a surface road once passed through, egg clutches among dead Brahmin and ants, and the remains of a family near a baby carriage in an isolated metro section. A makeshift bed and safe indicate prior habitation by scavengers or mercenaries, several of whom met their end within the tunnels. The caverns' existence is sometimes communicated to wastelanders through hand-drawn maps carried by adventurers who survive encounters near the surface.
topic_desc_basic: Rock Creek Caverns are a location in the Capital Wasteland, northwest of the National Guard Depot. The entrance is a sewer grate at the bottom of a crater that exposed the underlying sewer system. The caverns consist of a single large interior chamber with tunnels and offshoots connected to the old metro system. The area is inhabited by numerous Mirelurks, and some sections are moderately radioactive. Scavenger remains and supplies can be found scattered throughout.

topic_desc: Farragut West Station is part of the Capital Wasteland's derelict Metro tunnel network, connecting to Friendship Station and the broader underground transit system. Its main entry lies due east of the Super-Duper Mart. The station retains functional Protectron units that can be activated from office terminals, responding to Metro Tickets as credentials for passage. The interior transitions from relatively intact offices to progressively more deteriorated sections deeper within. Feral Ghouls occupy areas behind locked gates, and the station's infrastructure includes gas flow systems that remain operable through terminal controls. Pre-war publications and technical manuals survive in locked safes and behind secured doors, including U.S. Army flamethrower manuals, Tesla research materials, and DCTA laser firearms documentation. A room opposite the ghoul enclosure contains a naval cot and a terminal-linked safe, suggesting prior use as a shelter by scavengers or metro maintenance personnel who leveraged the station's security systems.
topic_desc_basic: Farragut West Station is a Metro station in the Capital Wasteland, part of the old underground tunnel system. Its main entrance is due east of the Super-Duper Mart. topic_desc: Arlington National Cemetery is an expansive burial ground in the Capital Wasteland, situated north of Mama Dolce's food factory and accessible via the Arlington Metro Station south of Wilhelm's Wharf. At its center stands the Arlington House, a pre-war structure that survived the nuclear exchange and subsequent centuries of neglect. The cemetery grounds also encompass the Arlington Monument, Arlington Utility, Arlington Falls Church Metro, and the Mama Dolce's facility, which has become a stronghold for Chinese Remnant soldiers. The cemetery's outdoor expanse is sparsely populated, with only a small number of raiders present. A Pulowski Preservation Shelter near the northern Metro station contains personal effects left behind by a previous occupant. The grounds retain rows of headstones, some still bearing flowers, suggesting periodic visitation or commemoration by someone in the wasteland. topic_desc: L'Enfant Plaza and L'Enfant South are ruined urban areas in the Capital Wasteland, reachable through Hazmat Disposal Site L5 from the Mall Southwest or via the Irradiated Metro. Before the Great War, the plaza served as a major open-space commuting thoroughfare. In the post-war era, it has become territory dominated by Super Mutants. The office building in L'Enfant South once housed the Capitol Post newspaper, and its computers still contain the text of articles that appear on loading screens throughout the region. The building's basement holds the remains of an individual named Gibson, along with a key and note directing attention to a house in the settlement of Minefield. The L'Enfant Café and Madame Jealle's shop represent the remnants of the area's commercial district. A makeshift camp beneath a collapsed overpass indicates prior scavenger activity. The plaza's central crossroads has been the site of vertical aircraft landings by Enclave forces, resulting in armed confrontations with the Super Mutant population. A burial mound in the southeast contains a search party log, suggesting organized expeditions into the area.

topic_desc: The Rockland Car Tunnel sits in the southwest reaches of the Capital Wasteland, a remnant of pre-War road infrastructure that the Enclave repurposed as a forward access point to their Satellite Relay Station. The main tunnel entrance collapsed at some point, but a door built into the side wall permits entry. Inside, the short intact stretch bears the thrashed remains of the Enclave's former presence: barricades, turrets, supply crates, and the bodies of dead Enclave soldiers, some still wearing their power armor. Irradiated pools collect outside the gate near an intact army truck loaded with Aqua Pura crates. After the Brotherhood of Steel drove the Enclave from the tunnel, Knights and Scribes established a staging area within, using the corridor as a launching point for operations deeper into Enclave-held territory. Service corridors on the southwest and northeast ends connect the tunnel back to the Capital Wasteland and toward the Satellite Relay Station respectively. The surrounding area is notoriously dangerous, with hostile creatures frequently prowling near the irradiated pools outside the gates.

topic_desc: Maryland was a mid-Atlantic state of the former United States whose territory encompasses several locations of significance to wastelanders and historians alike. Fort Constantine, a pre-War military installation, lies within its borders. The presidential retreat known as Camp David was also located in Maryland. The coastal region of Point Lookout, founded by English settlers aboard two ships that landed in 1634, gained a reputation as a haunted place and remained a distinct cultural pocket even after the Great War. Before the war, the influential Calvert family held enough political power to own approximately half the state, and their rivalry with the Lockhearts shaped local history. Industrial operations such as Thicket Excavations ordered materials from Maryland companies in Rockville and Damascus. The Western Maryland Correctional Facility later became associated with the Free Radicals. Pre-War intelligence reports indicated Chinese activity in Maryland, leading to search efforts that resulted in the capture of suspected Chinese operative Wan Yang. An unidentified flying object crashed near Hagerstown on May 3, 2062. Baltimore served as a hub for specialist medical care and was home to companies such as the Branson Repeating Arms Company.

topic_desc: The Sub Recovery Site comprises the wreck of the Chinese submarine SSN-37-1A, lying submerged in the waters off Point Lookout's coast. Before the Great War, the United States military had been actively recovering the vessel, which had fallen into American hands under circumstances that left the crew dead or captured. The submarine's skipper killed himself, and a surviving submariner—designated John Doe—attempted the same, but his cyanide dental capsule failed. He was subsequently transferred to Turtledove Detention Camp. Chinese intelligence, unwilling to let the Americans analyze the submarine, dispatched Agent Jiang to destroy it. Jiang posed as a defector and sought Agent Yang, who carried the submarine's self-destruct codes concealed in a dental capsule. Above the waterline, a small stranded boat and a buoy mark the location. Below, the submarine's interior contains two beds, a mainframe computer, a leaking generator, and irradiated water covering the floor. The vessel sits adjacent to another inaccessible submarine wreck. The Chinese Intelligence Ministry later confirmed mission success through orbital intelligence verification.

topic_desc: Pilgrim's Landing was once a bustling seaside vacation destination in Point Lookout, its pre-War boardwalk signage promising it was open all year. The Great War reduced the attraction to a shadow of its former self, though the boardwalk and several structures remain standing. The Amazing Wheel of Wonder, a now-inactive Ferris wheel, dominates the skyline as a monument to the resort's vanished heyday. The House of Wares sits a short distance north along the boardwalk. In the post-War era, the landing serves as a modest hub for the region's sparse inhabitants. Tobar the Ferryman operates his vessel, the Duchess Gambit, from here, ferrying travelers between Point Lookout and the Capital Wasteland. Madam Panada maintains a presence in the area, and Nadine has been known to reside here after certain events. A Protectron unit patrols the premises. The boardwalk lockers serve as convenient storage for travelers, and smugglers frequently pass through, making the area unpredictable. A Mini Nuke rests beneath a buoy near the ferry, and a spy's audio password holodisk can be found in a boardwalk locker during intelligence operations connected to the submerged Chinese submarine off the coast.

topic_desc: The Cave of the Abaddon sits deep in the Divide, a landscape scarred by Old World destruction. The cave itself was formed when surface structures collapsed into subterranean voids, leaving fragments of pre-War architecture suspended in the rock—a swimming pool can even be seen embedded upside-down in the ceiling near the entrance. The buried buildings within serve as a transitional passage connecting the cave system to the Boxwood Hotel Roof above. The area is notoriously dangerous due to heavy tunneller infestation, including a tunneller queen. Among the debris lie the remains of Sunflower Summers, whose diary rests in a nearby suitcase. An Auto-Doc unit stands near the exit to the buried buildings, though reports indicate it does not treat addictions despite performing other medical functions. The name "Abaddon" derives from Hebrew, meaning destruction, and references the angel of the abyss in the Book of Revelation—an apt description for a place where Old World ruins and subterranean predators converge.
topic_desc_basic: The Cave of the Abaddon is a passage in the Divide, formed largely from collapsed buildings. It is the only known route to Ulysses' Temple. topic_desc: The Outcast Outpost occupies the unfinished remains of a Virtual Strategic Solutions (VSS) military bunker in the Capital Wasteland. The pre-War facility was still under construction when the bombs fell—only the superstructure, elevator shaft, and VSS Bunker were completed. The Brotherhood Outcasts, led by Protector McGraw, established themselves in the ruins with the goal of breaching a sealed armory containing advanced technology. The outpost's interior includes a nuclear generator room, a research room with a password-protected VSS terminal, a medical bay, and the coveted armory itself. A dead Gary clone—Gary 23, identifiable by his Vault 108 jumpsuit and a dismembered arm—is found in the medical room, suggesting the Outcasts or others experimented with Vault clones. The surface entrance is a half-made structure defended by three Outcast guards, who frequently clash with super mutants from the surrounding area. Specialist Olin operates the facility's neural interface technology, which ties into an Anchorage Reclamation simulation housed within the bunker. The Outcasts' presence here reflects their broader mission of recovering and cataloguing advanced technology, a goal that put them at odds with the main Brotherhood chapter in the Citadel.

topic_desc: Bailey's Crossroads Metro is a small surviving section of the Capital Wasteland's pre-War transit network, consisting of a single mezzanine level with exits to the surface and to Bailey's Crossroads proper. The main entrance from the Capital Wasteland is choked with rubble, forcing travelers to use a nearby service tunnel. The station is infested with feral ghouls, making passage hazardous. The lower level reveals grim evidence of post-War violence: a cage where someone was left to die in brutal fashion, and a skeleton suspended above the ticket booth. A hidden area behind wrecked metro cars contains a makeshift target range with a BB gun and assorted supplies, suggesting someone used the station as a shelter or staging area at some point. A makeshift bedding and a sawed-off shotgun with shells can be found near the caged area. The station's proximity to the Outcast Outpost at Bailey's Crossroads makes it a natural approach route for anyone seeking the VSS Facility, though the ghoul population and structural decay make it a dangerous passage.

topic_desc: The Chimera Armor Depot exists within the Anchorage Reclamation simulation, a virtual recreation of the pre-War Chinese invasion of Alaska housed in the VSS Facility's neural interface system. The depot represents a fortified Chinese armored vehicle staging area during the simulated Battle of Anchorage. General Constantine Chase, the simulation's commanding officer, identifies the depot as a critical objective, ordering forces to breach its perimeter and destroy the Chimera fuel tanks. The Chimera was a type of Chinese armored vehicle deployed during the Alaska campaign, and the fuel tanks at the depot were essential to its operation. Destroying them would cripple Chinese armored capabilities in the simulated theater. The depot's inclusion in the simulation reflects the strategic importance of logistics and fuel infrastructure in the real Anchorage campaign, where both American and Chinese forces struggled to maintain supply lines in harsh arctic conditions. The simulation's fidelity to historical events has been questioned by some who served under Chase, though the depot itself appears consistent with known Chinese defensive positions around Anchorage.

topic_desc: The Saturnite Alloy Research Facility sits in the southwestern reaches of Big MT, southeast of the Z-43 Innovative Toxins Plant. It was built atop a natural cave system exposing an underground lava flow, which researchers harnessed for metallurgical work. Saturnite is a remarkable alloy that retains heat so effectively that a blade forged from it can melt metal on contact. The facility produced and tested Cosmic Knives, advertised near the entrance. The factory floor is now overrun by crazed Mister Handy units, with a unique unit called Sparks guarding the lower cave behind a force field that requires a sonic emitter to disable. A pit of molten steel sits in the facility's depths, and raw superheated Saturnite bars rest at the rear of the building. An Old World flag painted in blue marks the exterior, left by Ulysses. The facility's lobby contains desks, computers, and a Sunset Sarsaparilla vending machine, while upper tunnels connect to the main cave below.

topic_desc: The X-7b "Boom Town" Target Zone is a mock settlement in the eastern Big MT, paired with the X-7a "Left Field" Artillery Launch facility. It was constructed expressly to test the performance of Saturnite artillery shells against simulated civilian structures. The entire area remains heavily irradiated as a lasting side effect of weapons testing, with craters filled with green radioactive material scattered throughout. The site echoes real-world nuclear testing practices, where replica towns populated with mannequins and provisions were subjected to detonations to study structural and material damage. A bombed-out building at the site bears an Old World flag painted in red, left by Ulysses. The mock houses contain remnants of pre-war consumer goods, and a footlocker in one crater holds an Atomic-Valence Tri-Radii-Oscillator accessible after the fixed artillery gun at X-7a is fired. The surrounding fence line and hilltops conceal additional cached supplies.

topic_desc: Hopeville was one of two towns in the Divide, alongside Ashton, both situated above an extensive network of nuclear silos built by the Commonwealth Defense Administration Ballistic Defense Division. The region was geologically unstable, with minor earthquakes common. The Army selected Hopeville as the site for Big MT's weather control research. The town proper was hemmed in by walls, terrain features, and superhighways, with buildings clustered along the road passing through. Two main gates connected the town to the missile base. The northwestern corner held a fire station and shops serving base personnel, while the opposite end contained industrial and office buildings. The missile base occupied the western part, separated by chain-link fences and fortified walls, with an entrance carved into the western cliffs leading to the Hopeville missile silo. The Solitare gas station sat on the public road, separating the silo from the base. The base was bisected by a road, with the northern section housing the command center and barracks, and the southern section containing the loading station and armory. Two centuries of neglect and subsequent devastation left little trace of civilian life, with ruins now serving as Marked Men outposts.

topic_desc: The Ashton Missile Silo is an underground facility in the Divide, built before the Great War to store nuclear missiles for launch via the Ashton Silo Control Station. The silo's interior is extensive and multi-leveled. Entry leads through a long room to a transport lift descending to the lower levels, where tunnelers roam the corridors. The level 1 launch deck features a catwalk leading to rooms secured behind hard-locked blast doors, including a medical room guarded by a sentry bot and containing an Auto-Doc and Commissary Terminal. Level 2 holds a locked storeroom and a locker containing riot gear. Level 3 is largely wrecked, with a blast crater from a launched missile marking the devastation. The silo connects to the Sunstone Tower Roof via an exit past the crater. Tunnelers infest the deeper passages, making navigation hazardous. The facility represents the Commonwealth Defense Administration's extensive ballistic missile infrastructure beneath the Divide, part of the same silo network that underlay both Ashton and Hopeville.

topic_desc: Angel Cave serves as the primary dwelling of Joshua Graham within Zion Canyon, situated in the Eastern Virgin region as part of the Dead Horses Camp. The cave's layout consists of two main rooms: a modest camp area with several tents near the entrance, and a larger cavern further within where Graham maintains a workspace featuring a workbench, a workbench crate, and a reloading bench. The rear exit opens onto an enclosed clifftop area containing additional Dead Horses camp facilities and, in its far corner, one of six hidden survivalist caches left by the survivalist who once inhabited Zion. A hollowed-out rock sits on the cliffs above the lower entrance, accessible via rock arch bridges from a path east of the cave. The cave contains significant quantities of harvestable cave fungi. Several .45 Auto Pistols rest on a desk near Graham's seat, with another in good condition stored in a footlocker behind his chair. A cup of black coffee can also be found in that footlocker. The cave's ambient music is notably the same piece used in the Cathedral of the original Fallout.

topic_desc: The Yao Guai Cave in Zion Canyon is a network of small tunnels converging on a large central cavern that serves as the den for three yao guai. Navigation through the cave involves multiple forks: the uphill right path dead-ends at two skeletons, while the left downhill path is the viable route. A subsequent fork offers a straight path leading to a high vantage point above the central cavern, though an invisible barrier limits attacks from this position unless the yao guai are positioned along the western wall or near the center. The alternative left fork leads through a partially submerged tunnel to another fork, where the right path reaches the central cavern and the left path dead-ends. Daniel of the Sorrows tribe has proposed sealing the cave using mining explosives placed at three designated areas within the tunnels, a measure intended to eliminate the threat posed by the resident yao guai. Even if all three creatures are killed beforehand, they may reappear when the cave is revisited. Once the explosives are detonated, the area becomes permanently inaccessible, though nothing of significant value remains inside.

topic_desc: The X-8 Research Center, formally designated the X-8 Bio-Mechanical Testing Facility, is situated at the far eastern edge of Big MT. The facility was dedicated to biomechanical experimentation, with its most significant project involving the creation and testing of cyberdogs. Dr. Borous, one of the Big MT researchers, personally oversaw this endeavor and used his own pet dog, Gabe, as a test subject. Gabe was eventually converted into a cyberdog and sealed within a section of the facility. The K9000 Cyberdog Gun was also developed at X-8. The facility's testing area was designed to resemble an American high school, ostensibly for infiltration testing but actually intended to evaluate cyberdogs' ability to detect infiltrators. The institutional test facility includes a locker hallway, stairway, coach's office, two classrooms, a library, and a janitor's room. The phrase "WHY ME MOBIUS" is scrawled on a wall in the high school area. The facility suffered a critical incident when a shipment of nightstalkers arrived in place of standard dogs; upon release, the creatures massacred the shipping department, leaving only Skippy as a survivor and causing the area to be locked down. The X-8 splicing facility terminal allows the combination of different creatures, including robots, lobotomites, dogs, and nightstalkers, producing various results ranging from hostile robobrains to failed experiments. A temporary cyberdog named Roxie can be created by splicing a dog and robot together, though she cannot leave the facility.
topic_desc_basic: The X-8 Research Center, also called the X-8 Bio-Mechanical Testing Facility, is a location at Big MT. topic_desc: Z-38 Lightwave Dynamics Research is a two-story facility located in the western region of Big MT, positioned southwest of the Z-43 Innovative Toxins Plant. The facility was historically connected to the hologram project commissioned for the Sierra Madre Casino. The project's completion was delayed when Frederick Sinclair, the casino's creator, requested that the holograms be equipped with defensive capabilities. Sinclair also specifically ordered the creation of a flawless hologram of Vera Keyes, the casino's intended star performer. Two non-hostile holograms remain active within the facility to this day. The building is accessible through two entrances: a main entrance on the eastern side reached via concrete stairs, and a backdoor entrance on the southern side accessed through metal stairs. The first floor contains a Sunset Sarsaparilla vending machine, several desks, a terminal, a photograph of Vera Keyes, and a central column of blueish light. A tool cabinet sits near the western wall. The second floor consists of multiple catwalks holding machinery. A notable feature is the column of light at the center of the first floor, which contains a Valence Radii-Accentuator. Stepping into this light beam causes a loss of motor control, followed by a blackout lasting approximately twelve hours. The facility's exterior is patrolled by lobotomites and a pack of nightstalkers. Among the items recoverable from the facility are proton throwing axes, plasma grenades, scrap electronics, duct tape, and energy weapons skill book recipes.

topic_desc: The Artillery Overlook is a fortified Chinese emplacement within the Operation: Anchorage simulation, a virtual recreation of the pre-War Anchorage Campaign preserved in a Brotherhood of Steel Outcast bunker. The overlook consists of a large facility mounting three heavy artillery guns that bombard American military positions throughout the simulated engagement. The guns represent a significant obstacle to the simulated American advance, requiring direct assault to neutralize. The location reflects the brutal, entrenched nature of the real Anchorage Campaign, where Chinese forces constructed extensive fortifications to hold the Alaskan front against the American counteroffensive. The simulation itself was maintained by General Constantine Chase as both a training tool and a record of one of the most pivotal military engagements of the Sino-American War. The Overlook's heavy armament underscores the strategic difficulty American forces faced in dislodging Chinese artillery from elevated positions during the campaign.
topic_desc_basic: The Artillery Overlook is a military position within the Anchorage Reclamation simulation, operated by Chinese forces. topic_desc: Haven stands as the political and personal center of Ashur's regime in The Pitt. Before the Great War, the structure was one of several skyscrapers in downtown Pittsburgh. Following the Brotherhood of Steel's violent Scourge of The Pitt, Ishmael Ashur—a former Brotherhood paladin who remained behind—chose the building as his headquarters and founded his new order upon its ruins. The exterior is walled off with guarded catwalks, and a large sculpture flanked by periodic flame bursts marks the main entrance, guarded by Pitt Raiders. The interior spans three levels connected by staircases and a lift. The upper level houses Ashur's living quarters, where he keeps personal holotapes addressed to his daughter Marie, and a terminal controlling ceiling-mounted automated turrets. Sandra's laboratory occupies the other side of the upper floor, containing scientific equipment and research terminals. The central room serves as Ashur's audience chamber for meetings. Haven's architecture and defenses reflect Ashur's Brotherhood origins—combining military discipline with the brutal pragmatism required to rule The Pitt. The building was modeled after Pittsburgh's Cathedral of Learning.
topic_desc_basic: Haven is the headquarters of Ishmael Ashur, ruler of The Pitt, located in the uptown section of the city. Before the Great War, it was a skyscraper in downtown Pittsburgh. topic_desc: The Pitt Downtown serves as the oppressive labor heart of Ashur's domain in The Pitt. Before the Brotherhood of Steel's Scourge, downtown—like the rest of Pittsburgh—was lawless and controlled by Raider gangs. After Ashur consolidated power by assimilating or killing rival Raiders, the surviving citizens of The Pitt were forced into downtown to live as slaves, cutting metal and performing industrial labor. The district stands in stark contrast to Uptown, where Ashur and his Raider lieutenants reside in relative comfort. Downtown's layout centers around a work zone where slaves process scrap metal under Raider supervision. Key locations include The Mill, the primary industrial worksite; Midea's Quarters, home to a slave who serves as a community organizer; Vertigo Bar and Grill; and Friday's Repairs. Pre-War postal terminals on the upper level preserve fragments of Pittsburgh's history before the bombs fell. The atmosphere is one of constant degradation—slaves are beaten on catwalks, and some are confined in brutal restraints. Downtown embodies the cruelty of Ashur's system, where the cure for The Pitt's rampant trog disease depends on the labor and suffering of an enslaved population.
topic_desc_basic: The Pitt Downtown is the slave district of The Pitt, inhabited by enslaved workers and their Raider overseers. Before the Brotherhood's Scourge, it was a lawless area controlled by Raider gangs. Under Ashur's rule, surviving citizens were sent downtown to live as slaves. It contrasts with the relatively privileged Uptown section and contains key locations including The Mill, Midea's Quarters, and several shops.

topic_desc: Old Olney Underground is a sprawling subterranean network beneath the ruins of Old Olney, accessible through Olney Sewers. The complex is divided into several distinct sections: a residential area once used by a group of Ghouls, the remains of a pre-War children's hospital, utility corridors beneath the hospital, and tunnels connecting to the Old Olney S. Wilson Building. A group of Ghouls—Kidd, Wint, and their now-deceased companions Badger, Connelly, Dunbar, Carl, and Sanders—attempted to establish a colony here but disturbed a Deathclaw nest, leaving Kidd and Wint as the only survivors. The hospital and basement levels contain skeletons, fortifications, and weapons caches suggesting a large battle occurred long before the Ghouls arrived. Relatively recent tunneling indicates one faction may have attempted to burrow toward an enemy. The identities of the combatants, the era of the conflict, and the origin of the Deathclaw hive remain a mystery, though post-War humanitarian deterioration and rioting around the hospital is a possible explanation. A locked sub-basement storeroom contains the remains of two Chinese spies alongside a ham radio and military equipment, adding another layer of intrigue to the site's history. The underground is notoriously dangerous due to roaming Deathclaws that return to the area.
topic_desc_basic: Old Olney Underground is a subterranean complex beneath the ruins of Old Olney, accessible via Olney Sewers. It is infested with Deathclaws and was briefly inhabited by a group of Ghouls attempting to establish a colony. The tunnels include the remains of a children's hospital, utility sections, and evidence of a long-past battle. The identities of the original combatants remain unknown.

topic_desc: Fort Constantine served as a United States military base in Maryland dedicated to the construction and storage of nuclear ordnance, as well as the development of top-secret power armor. The installation comprises three main structures: the CO quarters, personnel offices, and bomb storage building, connected by an underground launch control bunker. The bomb storage doors are secured with very hard locks, though the cellar of the CO quarters provides an alternate subterranean route. Years before 2277, Allistair Tenpenny hired five mercenaries—Mister Crowley, Dave, Dukov, Jeff Strayer, and Tara Fields—to retrieve a rare weapon from the fort. Tara was killed by feral ghouls in the bunker, while Crowley, himself a ghoul, survived and discovered a suit of T-51b power armor held in a stasis field. Obsessed with reclaiming the armor, Crowley later plotted from Underworld to collect keys held by each surviving mercenary. The launch control terminal still contains functional launch codes, though any launch attempt fails due to corrupted navigation data and a damaged tracking system. Brotherhood Outcasts patrol the vicinity, and an Enclave camp sits to the east.
topic_desc_basic: Fort Constantine is a pre-war military installation in the northwest Capital Wasteland, between SatCom Array NW-05a and SatCom Array NN-03d. It once built and stored nuclear bombs and housed classified power armor development. The facility is heavily guarded by sentry bots, Mister Gutsys, robobrains, and protectrons. It contains a CO quarters, personnel offices, bomb storage, and a launch control bunker.

topic_desc: The Super-Duper Mart was a pre-war grocery franchise with a location on the banks of the Potomac in the Capital Wasteland. By 2277, the store has been thoroughly claimed by raiders, who use makeshift plank bridges between the supermarket shelves as patrol walkways. The parking lot features hanging corpses signaling the raider presence. The store's pharmacy, located on the back wall, contains significant medical supplies and a protectron unit that can be activated via terminal; the robot resumes its pre-war routine of requesting employee identification. The pharmacy key can be found in a crate within the mart, or the door can be bypassed through lockpicking or terminal hacking. The store was one of several locations that received a large shipment of Nuka-Cola Quantum, making it a notable source of the rare beverage. The surrounding area includes a Mirelurk nesting ground along the Potomac with dozens of eggs, and a camp under a bridge to the north. The Super-Duper Mart franchise had advertisements as far afield as the Mojave Wasteland, including the Sunset Sarsaparilla Headquarters and Mick & Ralph's in Freeside.
topic_desc_basic: The Super-Duper Mart is a pre-war grocery store near the Potomac River, northeast of Megaton and northwest of Grayditch in the Capital Wasteland. The building is completely overrun by raiders, who hang corpses in the parking lot as a warning. The interior contains supermarket shelving, a pharmacy, and a protectron unit that can be activated for security purposes. The store received a large shipment of Nuka-Cola Quantum before the war.

topic_desc: SatCom Array NN-03d is one of several satellite communications installations scattered across the northwest Capital Wasteland, situated between Fort Constantine and the MDPL-21 Power Station. The facility comprises three dish towers: NN-03d-A, B, and C. Tower A sees heavy raider activity at ground level, while B's front door is boarded shut. Towers A and B are linked by a bridge spanning the dish structures, and B and C connect via a basement tunnel. Tower C is locked but can be opened through a nearby terminal. The raiders occupying the array are known to return after roughly three days if cleared. The towers contain curious arrangements left by their occupants, including a chessboard using miniature garden gnomes and liquor bottles as pieces, carefully balanced sporks on a railing, and rows of beer bottles arranged as dominoes on a stairwell. Two mini nukes rest on a makeshift scarecrow atop tower C's dish. A Brotherhood Outcast outpost in a corrugated steel shack southwest of the array houses two outcasts, with two more patrolling the ridge-line toward Fort Constantine. The shack contains a workbench and shishkebab schematics. A sealed doorway set into the rock to the northeast reveals a concrete wall with profane graffiti, a remnant of incomplete construction.
topic_desc_basic: SatCom Array NN-03d is a satellite communications array in the northwest Capital Wasteland, located between Fort Constantine and the MDPL-21 Power Station. It consists of three satellite dish towers—designated A, B, and C—occupied by raiders. The towers are connected by bridges and underground passages. A small Brotherhood Outcast outpost sits at the base of the hill to the southwest.

topic_desc: The Temple of the Union is a sanctuary for escaped slaves in the Capital Wasteland, situated northwest of Canterbury Commons and south of the Grisly Diner. The community is led by Hannibal Hamlin, a former slave who holds near-reverent respect for Abraham Lincoln and seeks to establish a permanent safe haven at the Lincoln Memorial. The temple itself is a ruined three-story building where a stone head of Lincoln rests on a pedestal alongside a large inscribed block bearing the words "Temple of the Union." The compound is gated and guarded by residents including Simone, who controls entry. The temple's location can be learned through various means, including from escaped slaves encountered in the wasteland or from maps found on dead slaves. Hannibal is known to purchase Lincoln artifacts, reflecting the community's deep reverence for the abolitionist president. The temple serves as a stop-off point for caravan merchants. An elevated highway near the temple hosts a Vertibird landing zone where Enclave soldiers occasionally deploy, leading to clashes with raiders occupying a shack on the highway. Talon Company mercenaries have also been known to appear in the vicinity, sparking firefights with the temple's inhabitants. The surrounding area includes the unmarked Roach King's Throne to the west, halfway toward Minefield.
topic_desc_basic: The Temple of the Union is a ruined three-story building in the Capital Wasteland, northwest of Canterbury Commons and south of the Grisly Diner. It houses a small compound of escaped slaves led by Hannibal Hamlin, who reveres Abraham Lincoln as the man who ended slavery in America. The temple initially displays Lincoln's stone head on a pedestal. Hannibal dreams of relocating his people to the Lincoln Memorial for better defensibility.

topic_desc: Ulysses' Temple stands as both a dwelling and a monument within the Divide, reflecting Ulysses' deep fixation on Old World symbols and power. The entrance area is guarded by automated turrets and sentry bots, beyond which a computer terminal controls access to interior sections. The main chamber houses six nuclear missiles, three in holding frameworks in a pit to the left and three in a pit to the right. On the main level, numerous consoles include a launch control console used by Ulysses to prepare a loaded missile, and two eyebot control consoles situated at the far end of each missile pit. These eyebot consoles govern repair and medical eyebots that Ulysses makes use of in combat. Six loose warheads are scattered throughout the chamber, distinct from the warheads mounted on the missiles themselves. An Old World flag hangs toward the far end of the complex, where Ulysses himself can be found. The temple represents one of three missile silos located throughout the Divide.
topic_desc_basic: Ulysses' Temple is a location in the Divide, serving as the home of Ulysses and his shrine to the Old World. It is the largest nuclear silo found in the Divide, capable of launching several nuclear missiles simultaneously. The temple contains six nuclear missiles held in frameworks within pits on either side of the main level, along with a wide array of consoles.

topic_desc: The Hopeville Missile Base is a pre-war ballistic defense facility located in the Divide, reflecting the heavy military infrastructure that once defined the region. The western entrance consists of a women's barracks accessible only through detonating a warhead, and a gas station containing a workbench, toolboxes, a metal box, and a floor safe concealed behind large tires. A RALPHIE poster hangs on the gas station wall. To the northeast sits the Hopeville Missile Base Headquarters, guarded by Marked Men. The eastern entrance is situated close to a Marked Men camp, with the men's barracks directly across the street. A shipping crate behind the gas station is notable as the only known location in the wasteland where Nuka-Cola Quantum can be found, though only rarely. The base is connected to the Hopeville Missile Silo Bunker, and upon first exiting that bunker, Ulysses makes contact through ED-E. The facility stands as a testament to the Old World military presence that once anchored the community of Hopeville before the Divide's destruction.
topic_desc_basic: The Hopeville Missile Base, also called the Hopeville Ballistic Defense Station, is a military installation in the Divide. Its western entrance is marked with a sign reading "authorized military personnel only" and includes women's barracks and a gas station. The eastern entrance lies near a Marked Men camp, with the men's barracks across the street. The base headquarters lies to the northeast.

topic_desc: Alaska held enormous strategic significance in the pre-war Sino-American conflict. The USS Ebon Atoll was sunk off the coast of Alaska in 2066, and its flag was later recovered and displayed in the Museum of Technology in Washington, D.C. American troops fought across a vast front from Anchorage, Alaska to Shantou, China, as reported by the Boston Bugle. The Anchorage campaign became a defining chapter of the war, culminating in General Constantine Chase reclaiming Anchorage in January 2077. Liberty Prime, the Brotherhood of Steel's walking weapon, was originally designed to help liberate Alaska but was never completed in time for that purpose. The Capital Post covered the annexation of Canada and labeled Alaska on its maps, dividing the state into sections including "Far North," "Interior," "Southwest," and "Southcentral." The Alaskan front was broadcast on the People's Republic of America Radio. Tensions had been running high due to incidents in Alaska, as noted in incident reports. The Hubris Comics summer 2077 schedule included Tales from the Front: Alaska Unbowed, and medic Elliott Tercorien of the 108th Infantry Battalion was stationed in Anchorage. Munitions factories received questions about why bullets were not being sent to Alaska, and a terminal at Garrahan Mining Headquarters referenced the deteriorating situation there.
topic_desc_basic: Alaska is a state of the pre-war United States, located in the northwest of the North American continent with Canada to its east and Russia to the west across the Bering Strait. It was the site of a major conflict between American and Chinese forces, centered on Anchorage, which American forces under General Constantine Chase reclaimed in January 2077.

topic_desc: Bailey's Crossroads is a district on the outskirts of Washington, D.C. that became a point of contact between the Brotherhood Outcasts and the wider Capital Wasteland. The district is accessible via Bailey's Crossroads Metro and features a small plaza, a large ruined building infested with Super Mutants, and an elevator connecting to the Outcast Outpost. The Super Mutants in this area are notably aggressive and tend to reappear in the infested building more quickly than most of their kind elsewhere in the wasteland. The front door of the Super Mutant-held building has been observed opening on its own when approached, even when no one is visibly nearby. The Outcast Outpost within the district serves as a forward base for the Brotherhood Outcasts, who have established themselves there in connection with their interest in pre-war military simulation technology. The real-world Bailey's Crossroads, Virginia, is a suburb of Washington, D.C. known for large groups of apartment buildings, and is named after Hachaliah Bailey, ancestor of James Anthony Bailey of Barnum & Bailey's Circus.
topic_desc_basic: Bailey's Crossroads is a small district of Washington, D.C. inhabited by Super Mutants and Brotherhood Outcasts. It can be reached through Bailey's Crossroads Metro and consists of a metro exit, a small plaza, a large ruined building, and an elevator to the Outcast Outpost. The area is associated with the Outcasts' efforts to access pre-war military technology.

topic_desc: Recon Craft Theta is the wreckage of an unidentified alien vessel that plowed through a residential structure in the northern Capital Wasteland before embedding itself in a cliffside. The cockpit dome is shattered, and the pilot's body lies outside among scattered debris. The wreck leaks an unspecified radioactive substance that irradiates anyone approaching the front of the ship. The craft continuously transmits a distress signal designated the Recon Craft Theta Beacon, which can be detected at considerable distance. The signal grows louder as one nears the crash site, and radiation levels rise accordingly. The pilot clutches an alien blaster, and roughly 120 alien power cells are scattered around the immediate vicinity. The trail between the ruined house and the vessel is choked with immovable debris. The site is most easily located by following power cables north from the MDPL-13 Power Station. The origin and mission of the craft remain unknown, and no comparable vessel has been documented elsewhere in the Capital Wasteland. The alien pilot itself is peculiar: its body behaves more like a physical object than a standard corpse, exhibiting weightlessness and unusual rotational properties when handled.
topic_desc_basic: The Crashed Anomaly is an unmarked location in the Capital Wasteland, situated between the Clifftop Shacks and Greener Pastures Disposal Site. The remains of Recon Craft Theta crashed through a house and came to rest against a cliffside. A dead alien lies beside the wreckage, and the site leaks radioactive fluid. The craft broadcasts a distress beacon detectable on Pip-Boy radios across the wasteland.
tags: alien blaster,alien crash site,capital wasteland location,distress beacon,radioactive wreckage,recon craft theta

topic_desc: The Museum of Technology was a large educational institution on the National Mall dedicated to humanity's technological achievements. Its exhibits celebrated aviation milestones from the Wright Flyer I through P-51 Mustangs and fighter jets, and spaceflight accomplishments including the Virgo II lunar lander and the Delta IX rocket. A prominent exhibit honored Carl Bell, credited with the first human spaceflight on May 5, 1961, aboard the Defiance 7 capsule. The museum also featured a Vault-Tec Corporation demonstration vault, a walkthrough model showing bedroom, kitchen, and classroom sections with recorded promotional messages, including a promise of self-cleaning floors. A malfunctioning Copernicus Planetarium in the west wing still plays programs that loop erratically. The maintenance coordinator, Derek Remmings, documented office politics and facility operations on his terminal in 2077, including references to a sub-basement housing three fusion generators. Gun and armor exhibits featuring laser pistols and power armor were scheduled for 2078 but never opened. Since the Great War, the building has deteriorated significantly, with collapsed pillars, holes in the roof, and rubble throughout. Super mutants have established a presence inside, particularly near the deeper exhibit halls. The museum's proximity to Museum Station and the Mall makes it a landmark in the heart of the ruined capital.
topic_desc_basic: The Museum of Technology is a ruined pre-War museum on the southern side of the Mall in Washington, D.C. Before the Great War it housed exhibits on aviation, spaceflight, and Vault-Tec technology. The structure is now crumbling and occupied by super mutants. Notable exhibits include the Wright Flyer I, a P-51 Mustang, the Virgo II lunar lander, a Delta rocket, and a Vault-Tec demonstration vault model.
tags: carl bell spaceflight,museum of technology,national mall,super mutant occupied,vault tec exhibit,virgo ii lander

topic_desc: Fort Bannister was a pre-War military installation that suffered a direct atomic bomb strike during the Great War, becoming the epicenter of a bombardment that left the Irradiated Western Plains as the second most devastated region of the Capital Wasteland, behind only the D.C. Metro Ruins. The installation is organized in a square layout surrounded by chain-link fencing on three sides, with rocky hills bordering the west. Five destroyed buildings, a water tower, and multiple entrances to underground sections remain on the surface. The interior is divided into three sections: Fort Bannister Main, the Commanding Officer's Quarters, and Fort Bannister Bunker. The Main building contains two floors with inoperable terminals and wall-mounted safes. The Commanding Officer's Quarters are accessed through a sewer section littered with frag mines and connect to a derelict missile silo visible from the surface. This section houses barracks, an infirmary, a flooded reactor room, and the quarters of Commander Jabsco, the Talon Company leader, who is guarded by turrets and a Mister Gutsy robot. The Bunker section features rigged shotgun traps, a turbine room, and a very hard-locked exit to the surface. The Talon Company has extensively fortified the installation with ceiling-mounted turrets, frag mines, grenade bouquets, and other traps throughout the underground tunnels. The fort's missile silo bay doors remain visible among the surface ruins, a reminder of the installation's original military purpose.
topic_desc_basic: Fort Bannister is a ruined pre-War military installation in the Capital Wasteland, located north of Evergreen Mills and west of Bannister Crater. On the day of the Great War, it took a direct hit from an atomic bomb, making the surrounding Irradiated Western Plains among the most devastated areas of the wasteland. It now serves as the main headquarters of the Talon Company mercenary organization.

topic_desc: The National Archives was the pre-War agency responsible for preserving and documenting the United States government's most foundational records, including the Declaration of Independence, the Magna Carta, and the Bill of Rights. The building sits in the northeast part of the Mall, east of the Museum of History and north of the Museum of Technology, with the Mall Metro Station across from its back door. The entrance hall features a Guess and Win terminal testing knowledge of American history, with correct completion yielding prize vouchers redeemable for specialized mentats. The Rotunda for the Charters of Freedom lies at the heart of the building, surrounded by frag mines and vulnerable to super mutant assault from the surrounding Mall battlefield. Beneath the public areas lies an extensive sub-basement and archival secure wing system, protected by locked doors, security terminals, sentry bots, and turrets. The Declaration of Independence is housed in an archival strongroom behind a locked door controlled by a strongroom security terminal. A Protectron unit programmed to believe it is Button Gwinnett, the second signatory of the Declaration, stands guard over the document. The Bill of Rights and Magna Carta are stored in separate archival security safes within the secure wing east. The building is heavily trapped throughout, with rigged toilets, grenade-bouquet tripwires, frag mines, swinging battering rams, and booby-trapped terminals. A backup Protectron stasis system exists in the utility areas, with units that can be activated and reprogrammed with alternate AI sub-routines, including one designated Thomas Jefferson. The Archives administrator, Berkeley, maintained an office terminal controlling access to prize vouchers and safe contents.
topic_desc_basic: The National Archives is a pre-War building in central Washington, D.C., charged with preserving government and historical records including the Declaration of Independence, the Magna Carta, and the Bill of Rights. Located in the northeast part of the Mall, it is now inhabited by super mutants, centaurs, and robots. A Protectron claiming to be Button Gwinnett guards the Declaration in a secure strongroom.

topic_desc: The Y-17 Medical Facility sits in the Big MT research crater, directly southwest of the X-8 Research Center. Its main room spans two levels, filled with computers and desks arranged around a buried, inoperative Auto-Doc sunk into the lower center. A unique Mister Orderly robot designated Doctor Orderly MD PHD DDS operates here alongside two others of its kind. A force field secures a side room of holding cells, which can be disabled with an upgraded Sonic Emitter. One cell bears a small Brotherhood of Steel logo, and an upper terminal references the toxic cloud released into the Sierra Madre. The facility is notable as the complex where Christine Royce was disfigured, and Christine's COS Recon Armor can be found near the wreckage in the sunken center. The front door is marked with a red Old World flag painted by Ulysses. Patient log Y-17.0 is recorded in the holding cells area.
topic_desc_basic: The Y-17 Medical Facility is a Big MT location southwest of the X-8 Research Center. Its two-level main room contains computers, desks, and a buried, inoperative Auto-Doc. A Mister Orderly robot called Doctor Orderly MD PHD DDS resides here. A force-field-protected side room holds holding cells. The front door bears a red Old World flag painted by Ulysses. The facility is connected to Christine Royce's disfigurement and contains references to the Sierra Madre cloud.

topic_desc: The Securitron De-Construction Plant, also called the Automaton Deconstruction Plant, occupies the northeastern part of Big MT. Its exterior sign has partially collapsed, with fallen letters spelling 'Automaton Deconstruction' and only 'D,' 'R,' and 'O' remaining mounted. Picnic tables and radioactive barrels sit outside the east entrance behind a torn chain-link fence. Inside, patrolling securitrons guard the upper platform and main deconstruction floor. A unique securitron designated 010011110110111001100101—binary for 'One'—carries the Muggy Upgrade: Parts Production. The main deconstruction area contains a workbench, a disassembly line laden with scrap metal and scrap electronics, and a generator room. Sixteen fission batteries are distributed throughout the facility. The plant's internal layout mirrors the Robot Repair Center found in the Capital Wasteland. An Old World flag painted in red by Ulysses marks the entrance door. The roof of the generator room holds a skeleton with supplies, accessible by dropping from the catwalk.
topic_desc_basic: The Securitron De-Construction Plant is a Big MT facility in the northeastern part of the crater. Patrolling securitrons guard its interior, including a unique unit named 010011110110111001100111, binary for 'One.' The main deconstruction area contains a workbench and large quantities of scrap metal and electronics on a disassembly line. The entrance door bears a red Old World flag painted by Ulysses. The plant's interior layout is identical to the Capital Wasteland's Robot Repair Center.

topic_desc: The Z-14 Pepsinae DNA Splicing Lab is located in the eastern area of Big MT. An Old World flag painted by Ulysses marks its exterior. The lobby contains desks, filing cabinets, a deluxe chemistry set, and disturbing piles of mutilated body parts. Proton Throwing Axes can be found in this area. The lower section houses containment cells occupied by cazadores, some concealed behind doors. One cell contains a skeleton with a laser rifle and microfusion cells. Behind the large main door lies a medical lab where a unique cazador, Specimen 73, is confined. Dr. Borous has confirmed that his research at this facility led to the creation of cazadores by splicing tarantula hawk wasp DNA. The facility's name references Pepsinae, a subfamily of spider wasps that includes tarantula hawk wasps—the biological inspiration for the cazador. Specimen 73 carries an Atomic-Valence Tri-Radii-Oscillator, and an Auto-Doc Upgrade: Implant M-5 can be found on the surgical table in its room.
topic_desc_basic: The Z-14 Pepsinae DNA Splicing Lab is a Big MT facility in the eastern crater area. An Old World flag by Ulysses marks the entrance. The lobby contains a deluxe chemistry set and mutilated body parts. Cazadores roam the lower containment cells. A unique cazador called Specimen 73 is found in the medical lab behind the main door. Dr. Borous's research here created cazadores by splicing tarantula hawk wasp DNA.
